checkpoints.description: [1/6] Plan: zero-dependency evolution sandbox. Milestones: (1) package scaffold + bounded genome model with mutation/crossover; (2) tile world + deterministic engine tick loop; (3) species clustering + fossil record + analytics; (4) atomic persistence + full CLI + REPL; (5) web observatory (stdlib server + canvas); (6) hardening, docs and publish verification. Executing milestone 1 now: pyproject, primordia package, genome DTO, failing-first tests.

impact_assessment.why: User asked for a self-chosen project on AIKit's projects subsystem; Primordia is a new genre beyond the existing projects: a seeded, deterministic evolution sandbox with speciation and a fossil record.
impact_assessment.benefits: A reproducible biosphere (same seed => same history) with a verifiable model: property tests over gene bounds, determinism and speciation; terminal live view plus a browser observatory; public repo under Aegean-E.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: gene schema and save JSON freeze early - additive changes only; dependency: none (Python 3.10+ stdlib only); concurrency: single-writer state file with advisory lock; state: power-loss atomicity via temp+fsync+os.replace with .bak and quarantine.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for every behaviour change; gene bounds enforced inside the operators; atomic writes and corruption recovery mirror the house pattern; python aikit.py check primordia gates each milestone; an ADR precedes each commit.

checkpoints.description: [1/6] Genome model complete: 12 normalized bounded genes, seeded mutation scaled by the mutability gene, whole-gene crossover, genetic distance; ADR-001 recorded, G-001 schema-freeze rule added, README quick-ref filled; 17/17 tests green in 0.01s, aikit check primordia 4/4 gates; checklists: passed
